channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quem é Fernando Cerimedo, ex-estrategista de Milei preso na Bolívia
item.description: Argentine Fernando Cerimedo, former digital strategist for Javier Milei’s Argentina campaign and informal supporter of Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, was arrested in Bolivia on suspicion of shooting his ex-wife while disguised as a delivery driver. He had previously been indicted by Brazil’s Federal Police in 2024 in relation to the coup attempt investigation, though not charged by the PGR. Cerimedo also spread false claims about electronic voting fraud in Brazil’s 2022 election, including baseless allegations about unaudited machines and duplicate logs.

item.title: Sempre quis construir ponte, só quero paz para governar, diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, stated that if elected, he would maintain a positive and institutional relationship with the STF and only seek 'peace to govern'. The remark follows previous criticisms of the Supreme Court by the candidate.

item.title: Oposição questiona imparcialidade de Dino após afastamento de presidente do TCE-MA
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), leader of the opposition, criticized Minister Flávio Dino's STF decision to remove Daniel Itapary Brandão from the presidency of TCE-MA for 180 days, alleging bias. The measure was requested by the Federal Police within ongoing investigations.

item.title: Ibovespa sobe com Petrobras enquanto investidores buscam recuperação
item.description: The Ibovespa rose 0.7% after ten consecutive days of decline, driven by Petrobras' oil discovery in the Morpho well in the Foz do Amazonas basin and rising Brent prices abroad. Petrobras shares gained 1.55%, while the dollar edged up due to Middle East tensions and the risk of a prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Petróleo da Margem Equatorial pode repor reservas do pré-sal
item.description: Petrobras confirmed an oil discovery at the Morpho well in the Equatorial Margin off Amapá, positioning it as a potential solution to offset declining pre-salt reserves expected after 2034. The region may hold up to 41 billion barrels and is seen as strategic to prevent Brazil from becoming a net oil importer post-2040, though exploration still requires environmental licensing and commercial viability validation.

item.title: Aliados de Lula se dividem sobre abordagem da campanha em caso Lulinha e temem desgaste
item.description: Allies of President Lula are divided on how to address new revelations involving his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), in investigations over suspected influence peddling. One group advocates speaking openly and showing Lula will not shield his son if wrongdoing is proven, while another prefers to avoid the topic to prevent unnecessary campaign damage. The internal disagreement hinders efforts to attack PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and his ties to Banco Master.

item.title: Mendonça determina remoção de vídeos de Lula por propaganda antecipada
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ordered the removal or editing of YouTube videos featuring explicit vote requests by Lula, Jerônimo Rodrigues, and the PT during a state convention in Salvador on August 1, 2026. The ruling, initiated by Novo, classifies the statements as premature electoral propaganda, despite being made at a partisan event, and grants a 24-hour deadline for compliance.

item.title: Flávio diz que estimulou rivais da direita e reclama de "ataques"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) said he encouraged the candidacies of his right-wing rivals but criticized Romeu Zema (Novo) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) for launching 'attacks' against his campaign, calling the strategy misguided. He claimed internal polling shows him ahead of Lula, despite public surveys indicating a technical tie or slight Lula lead. Flávio argued that uniting the right is essential to prevent a PT government, which he believes would 'destroy the country'.

item.title: Cury diz que Bolsa Família “perpetua os pobres na pobreza”
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) criticized the Bolsa Família program, stating it perpetuates poverty by discouraging beneficiaries from seeking employment or starting businesses. He advocated for reforming the program to promote economic autonomy during a meeting with presidential candidates hosted by UNECS in Brasília.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB diz ter temido golpe e “ruptura entre tropas”
item.description: Former Brazilian Air Force commander Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior stated that Brazil faced an imminent risk of institutional rupture after the 2022 elections, due to pressures on the Armed Forces to block Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s inauguration. He reported that Jair Bolsonaro presented alternatives to military commanders to alter the election outcome and remain in power, but that his resistance — shared by then Army commander General Marco Antônio Freire Gomes — was decisive in preventing the proposal from advancing within the Armed Forces.

item.title: Crusoé: Marçal quer ser antagonista de Renan
item.description: Pablo Marçal, the PRTB presidential candidate for 2026, stated in early interviews that Renan Santos, the Missão party candidate, will be his main target of criticism until at least October 4. Marçal accused Renan of copying his 2024 campaign strategies and highlighted personal differences, such as marital status, number of children, and tax situation, claiming he does not owe taxes to the state.

item.title: Consultor aliado ao clã Bolsonaro é preso após a morte da esposa
item.description: Fernando Cerimedo, an Argentine political strategist allied with the Bolsonaro clan and former advisor to Javier Milei, was arrested in Bolivia on suspicion of ordering the murder of his wife, Natalia Belén Basil, in a shooting attack. He was detained at Santa Cruz de la Sierra airport after local investigators alleged he hired hitmen to kill her. Cerimedo had previously been indicted by Brazil’s Federal Police for spreading false claims about electronic voting machines in 2022 and was named in the investigation into the alleged coup plot that led to Jair Bolsonaro’s conviction.

item.title: A posição política de Laura Cardoso, que diferia dos colegas de TV
item.description: Laura Cardoso, a respected actress, maintained a reserved stance toward specific candidates in Brazilian elections, avoiding direct public statements about Lula or Bolsonaro. Nevertheless, she frequently expressed dissatisfaction with the Brazilian political class and advocated for the importance of culture and voting as a civic right, including casting her ballot at age 95 in recent elections. She affirmed her faith in the democratic process and electronic voting machines, criticizing what she perceived as wrong in politics without ideologically aligning with the left-leaning tendencies of the artistic milieu.

item.title: TSE manda Lula retirar do ar trechos de convenção em que pede voto
item.description: TSE Vice President André Mendonça ordered Lula’s campaign to remove from online platforms excerpts from the PT-BA convention where he asked for votes for himself and Senate candidates Jacques Wagner and Rui Costa, as such requests before August 16 are illegal under electoral law. The ruling partially granted a petition by the Novo party, stating the speeches constitute 'direct electoral commands' even without literal use of 'vote' or 'elect'. Google/YouTube was also ordered to act on content from the 'Salvador TV' channel.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que pesquisa interna já o coloca à frente de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) claims his campaign's internal polling shows him ahead of Lula in a potential runoff, though registered polls show a technical tie with Lula leading by three points. He made the statement during a press conference in Belo Horizonte, where he also joined Nikolas Ferreira in a campaign event. Internal tracking polls are not public because they are not officially registered.

item.title: Mendonça manda Lula e PT retirarem vídeos com pedidos de voto
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ordered the removal of excerpts from President Lula's speech at the PT's Bahia state convention due to explicit vote requests made before the official start of electoral campaigning. The decision was issued on Monday night, the 17th, following a complaint alleging electoral law violations. The ruling aims to ensure fairness among candidates and compliance with the electoral calendar.

item.title: Em gesto institucional, Tarcísio sai em defesa de Marina Silva após episódio na capital
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) publicly defended federal deputy and Senate candidate Marina Silva (REDE-SP) after she was subjected to a political violence incident in São Paulo. He condemned the attack, expressed solidarity, and urged law enforcement to conduct a rigorous investigation to identify and punish those responsible, emphasizing that while protest is constitutionally protected, intimidation has no place in the electoral process.

item.title: Crusoé: Argentino das urnas é detido na Bolívia
item.description: Argentine Fernando Cerimedo, known for publishing a video questioning Brazilian electronic voting machines in 2022, was detained in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. He is an advisor to Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz and previously worked on the team of Argentine President Javier Milei.

item.title: Zema diz que, se eleito, primeiro ato será 'acabar com as bets'
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, stated that his first act as president would be to ban betting houses ('bets') in Brazil, comparing gambling addiction to chemical dependency. He also advocated for administrative and pension reforms, spending cuts to lower interest rates to 6% per year, reducing the number of ministries to 22 or 23, toughening public security policies against organized crime, and strengthening dialogue with the United States while refusing to concede on Pix and rare earth exploration.

item.title: Apesar de reaproximação com Lula, Alcolumbre descarta apoiar nova indicação de Messias
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre and Lula appeared together publicly for the first time after three private meetings in recent weeks, signaling a rapprochement between them. However, Alcolumbre reiterated that he will not support a new nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court, which was previously rejected by the Senate.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio promete usar imagem do pai “no limite da lei”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) pledged to use the image of former President Jair Bolsonaro, including AI-generated material, during his 2026 presidential campaign, stating he will act 'within the limits of the law' and await legal guidance on permissible boundaries under electoral legislation. The statement followed the display of an AI-generated video of his father during his candidacy formalization.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro começa campanha em São Paulo pela zona leste nesta quinta-feira
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will launch his electoral campaign in São Paulo this Thursday (20), with an agenda in the eastern zone, including visits to the São Miguel Paulista Municipal Market and a Solidarity Warehouse, followed by lunch with traders in Mooca, alongside Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB). The presence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas remains unconfirmed. The senator aims to expand his voter base in the capital and metropolitan region, following Jair Bolsonaro’s loss in São Paulo in 2022.

item.title: Há muito tempo não existe trabalho sério de segurança pública em São Paulo, critica Haddad
item.description: Former Finance Minister and PT candidate for São Paulo governor, Fernando Haddad, criticized the current governor Tarcísio de Freitas' public security management, stating that there has been no serious work in the area for a long time. The remarks were made during a sabatina on Jovem Pan radio on Tuesday morning, the 18th.

item.title: TSE se reúne nesta terça-feira para discutir uso de IA nas eleições e regras para deepfakes
item.description: The TSE is meeting this Tuesday to establish rules on the use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, focusing on restrictions for deepfakes. The debate features two positions: one advocating a broad ban on AI-manipulated content, another favoring restrictions only on false or misleading information. The discussion was prompted by a case involving an AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro used in Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign.

item.title: 80% dos municípios têm menos de 10 km² de áreas urbanizadas
item.description: Around 80% of Brazilian municipalities have less than 10 km² of urbanized areas, according to IBGE, showing a strong concentration of urban occupation in a few major centers. Meanwhile, the 20 municipalities with the largest urbanized areas exceed 150 km² each, including 15 state capitals and cities such as Campinas, Guarulhos, and Ribeirão Preto. São Paulo leads with 922,41 km² of urbanized area, representing 60.64% of its total territory.

item.title: Sem cargo formal, Janja ajuda a definir rumos da campanha de Lula
item.description: Although Janja Lula da Silva holds no formal position in Lula’s re-election campaign, she plays a strategic role by participating in internal decisions, coordinating events, mobilizing female voters, and influencing the campaign’s agenda. She determined the order of performances, proposed Fafá de Belém’s appearance at the campaign launch, and maintains direct contact with Lula, PT president Edinho Silva, and campaign strategist Raul Rabelo. Her involvement is described as continuous and structural, with independent state-level activities and regular meetings at PT headquarters in Brasília.

item.title: Haddad diz que Brasil “não precisa” dos EUA e vai exportar “pra todo lugar”
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that Brazil should surpass the United States in food exports by the end of 2026, emphasizing that the country does not need the U.S. to thrive. He proposed a state-level rural insurance program complementing the federal Plano Safra, recovery of state research institutes, revision of urban tolls, and resumption of the Melhor Caminho road conservation program. On security, Haddad advocated for an integrated institutional cabinet, WhatsApp-based police reports with AI support, and criticized São Paulo's low crime resolution rates.

item.title: Marçal corrige valores e diz ter R$ 149 milhões em vez de R$ 7 bilhões
item.description: Pablo Marçal, presidential candidate for the PRTB, corrected his asset declaration to the TSE, reducing his declared wealth from R$7 billion to R$149.9 million, citing material typing errors. Despite the candidacy being registered, Marçal remains ineligible until 2032 due to Electoral Justice convictions related to his 2024 São Paulo mayoral campaign.

item.title: Fotógrafo de campanha de Lula viaja de avião oficial da Presidência
item.description: Ricardo Stuckert, a photographer affiliated with Lula's campaign, traveled on an official presidential aircraft to accompany President Lula during a visit to a Petrobras survey vessel in Amapá, where oil was confirmed at the Morpho well. The use of a government aircraft by a non-presidential staff member has raised concerns, according to Folha de S.Paulo.

item.title: Sem dar o apoio do União a Flávio, Rueda espera estar no palanque dos Bolsonaro no RJ
item.description: Antônio de Rueda, national president of União Brasil and federal deputy candidate for Rio de Janeiro, said he expects to be on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign slate in the 2026 elections, despite the União-PP federation declaring neutrality in the presidential race. He stated there are no hard feelings with Bolsonaro and that many of his allies support the senator, reinforcing his intention to campaign alongside him and Douglas Ruas. Rueda aims to secure at least 100,000 votes and help elect up to eight União candidates to the Chamber of Deputies from Rio.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Fala de Kassab sobre ‘zero’ chances de Flávio escancara disputa na oposição e anima petistas
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, the PSD's vice-presidential candidate, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro has 'zero' chances of being elected, triggering backlash from Bolsonaro's base and delight among petistas. The comment exposed fractures within the opposition and raised doubts about Flávio's electoral viability in a potential runoff against Lula, despite Kassab later attempting to clarify that the remark aimed to pressure the PL into weakening its candidate.

item.title: Flávio diz que autoridades do Judiciário afastaram apoio do Centrão
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) claimed that Judicial authorities pressured Centrão parties to withdraw support for his presidential candidacy, stating the system fears his rise. Despite lacking formal backing, he emphasized that key Centrão figures — including Teresa Cristina, Dani Marques, Simone Marquetto, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Ricardo Nunes — remain allies and will play significant roles in his potential government.

item.title: Mendonça manda Lula tirar do ar trechos de discurso com pedido de voto em convenção na Bahia
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered Lula's team and PT allies to remove from online platforms excerpts of a speech made at the PT's Bahia convention, where Lula requested votes before the official campaign period. The decision partially grants a request from the Novo party, noting that only certain parts of the over-three-hour video constitute irregularities due to explicit vote requests prematurely. The measure aims to ensure equal conditions among candidates by banning pre-campaign vote solicitation.

item.title: Lula atirou Toffoli aos leões em ato de campanha
item.description: During a campaign rally for his re-election in São Bernardo do Campo, Lula improvised by referencing an episode with Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli, comparing how a police deputy allowed him to attend his mother’s burial during the dictatorship, while Toffoli denied him permission to attend his brother Vavá’s funeral under democracy. The remark was seen as a calculated signal that Lula would not block a potential impeachment of Toffoli, reinforcing his positioning as an 'anti-system' candidate.

item.title: Zema diz que programas sociais criam 'geração de imprestáveis'
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Zema criticized social programs, claiming they are creating a 'generation of unemployables' who refuse to work and prefer informal jobs ('bicos'), which he argues do not qualify professionals and are being passed down from parent to child.

item.title: Alessandra Negrini, Gil e outros artistas assinam manifesto por Dirceu
item.description: The campaign of former minister José Dirceu (PT) for federal deputy in São Paulo circulated a manifesto signed by artists such as Alessandra Negrini and Gil, endorsing his candidacy. Due to lymphoma treatment, Dirceu is unable to campaign in person. The manifesto emphasizes his importance to Brazil and advocates for his presence in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai usar imagem do pai ‘no limite da lei’ e faz aceno a Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said he will use his father Jair Bolsonaro's image in his presidential campaign up to the legal limit, particularly through AI-generated videos, while seeking reconciliation with Michelle Bolsonaro after pre-campaign tensions. Michelle has resumed active campaigning, recording materials and soliciting votes for her brother-in-law despite past conflicts. The TSE will review the legality of using AI to depict candidates, with Flávio's defense arguing that illegality hinges on deceptive content, not lack of authorization.

item.title: Após Flávio e Caiado, Cury troca de marqueteiro a dias de início da campanha na televisão
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury of the Avante party changed his campaign strategist just days before the start of free electoral advertising on August 28. Leandro Grôppo departed due to financial and strategic disagreements, replaced by Sergio Lima, who previously worked on Cury’s pre-campaign and Bolsonaro’s 2018 bid. This shift is part of a broader trend of strategist changes among presidential contenders, including Vasconcelos (Caiado) and Carvalho (Flávio Bolsonaro).

item.title: Moraes autoriza ida de Bolsonaro a dentista no centro médico da PM
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to visit a dentist, but required the appointment to take place at the Military Police Medical Center in the Federal District under escort, citing security concerns. The defense had requested private care from dentist Fernanda Antunes Figueira Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but Moraes rejected the original location and mandated confidentiality of the date and time, authorizing cancellation if information is leaked.

item.title: Flávio tem 52% contra 35% de Lula no 2º turno no Paraná, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll released on August 18, 2026 shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leading with 52% voting intention in a hypothetical second round in Paraná, against 35% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). In the first round, Flávio leads with 44% versus Lula’s 31%. Lula is the most rejected candidate (56%), and the federal government’s management is disapproved by 62% of Paraná voters.

item.title: Caiado lança diretrizes para a Saúde com foco em filas do SUS e avaliação de hospitais
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) unveiled his health policy proposals, focusing on reducing SUS waiting times, digitalizing the system, strengthening telemedicine, and tying federal funding to quality indicators, clinical outcomes, and patient satisfaction — moving away from procedure-based funding.

item.title: Crusoé: O aceno de Flávio a Cleitinho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, made a political gesture in support of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo, the Republican candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, during the launch of Flávio Roscoe's campaign — also from the PL — for the same office. The gesture, made at an event in Minas Gerais, was seen as an effort to unite right-wing allies in the state despite the internal competition between the candidates.

item.title: Tarcísio se solidariza com Marina após hostilidade em campanha
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) issued a statement of solidarity with former Minister Marina Silva (Rede) after a man confronted her supporters during her Senate campaign, as captured in a video by Folha de S.Paulo. The incident occurred on Monday, the 17th, while Marina was recovering from a prior event.

item.title: Piauí tem maior disputa pelo Senado, com dez candidatos por vaga
item.description: Piauí will have the most competitive race for the two Senate seats in the 2026 elections, with 20 candidates registered with the TSE, equivalent to ten contenders per seat. This represents the highest level of competition for a Senate seat in the country this electoral cycle. The election will renew two-thirds of the Federal Senate, with two seats up for grabs in each state.

item.title: TSE: candidatos ao Senado em 2026 têm média de 50 anos
item.description: The 314 candidates for the Senate in 2026, according to TSE data, have an average age of 50 years, reflecting a predominantly male and middle-aged profile. The election will renew two-thirds of the Senate seats, with two seats contested in each state.

item.title: Tarcísio manifesta solidariedade a Marina, após homem tentar agredi-la
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) expressed solidarity with former Minister Marina Silva (Rede) after a man attempted to assault her during a campaign event in São Paulo. The statement was issued as a gesture of respect and condemnation of political violence.

item.title: Lula emociona, enquanto Flávio patina e derrapa no Rio
item.description: In São Bernardo do Campo, Lula filled the Vila Euclides stadium with over 12,000 people, appealing to emotion and his union roots. Flávio Bolsonaro drew about 10,000 in Copacabana — only 15% of Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 crowd — and made a political misstep by comparing himself to Pelé’s son, widely seen as a self-inflicted error. Noblat’s panel highlighted Flávio’s clear disadvantage in popular mobilization.

item.title: O presente eleitoral que a diretoria da Petrobras deu ao candidato Lula
item.description: Petrobras’ leadership presented candidate Lula with a fresh oil sample from a newly drilled well off the coast of Amapá, during a campaign filming session aboard a survey vessel. The discovery, hailed as ‘absolutely relevant’ by company president Magda Chambriard, was framed as an electoral gift, though Lula refrained from mentioning it in his São Bernardo do Campo rally. The gesture echoes the iconic ‘oil-stained hands’ imagery from the pre-salt era, reinforcing a nostalgic narrative of energy success despite criticism for relying on outdated rhetoric.

item.title: Quanto tempo o TSE vai demorar para analisar a candidatura de Marçal?
item.description: The TSE has until September 14 to review Pablo Marçal's presidential candidacy, despite his ineligibility until 2032. However, the Court is not expected to wait until the deadline and will likely rule sooner. The candidacy was filed by PRTB last Saturday, the 15th.

item.title: Eleições têm queda de quase 30% de candidatos; PL lidera registros e PT volta ao top 10
item.description: The number of candidates in the 2026 elections dropped 29.7% compared to 2022, falling from 29,262 to 20,530. The PL maintained the lead with 1,628 candidacies (7.93%), followed by MDB (1,391) and Novo and Republicans (1,296 each). The PT returned to the top 10 with 1,095 candidacies, despite registering fewer than in 2022.
